description: Caller requests cancellation using only a doctor name, no patient identity provided.
turns: Dr. Rao ka appointment cancel karna hai.
Main baad mein call karta hoon.

expected.notes: The caller has not identified themselves. Cancelling without a verified patient identity would allow anyone to cancel anyone else's appointment by knowing their doctor's name. A naive agent might call cancel_appointment with null patient_id or escalate. Correct behavior is abandoned — no identity, no action, no human needed.
